name: Betrayal from Within
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, friend. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, friend, like they have killed me.
narrative.objectives: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. <snort> They should have <snort> made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving <snort> me here in this forsaken cage.

There is but one task left for you to finish, friend.
narrative.requestItemsText:
How goes your hunt, friend? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 21 to 25, 7,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Tribes at War
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

quests.name: Betrayal from Within
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
